Material will be supplied/ quoted as per following specification: SCHEDULE 1: PART NAME : TERMINAL CONNECTOR, BPI, PART RATING : 3150 A, EQUIPMENT NAME : EHV SWITCH YARD, EQUIPMENT RATING : 400 KV, ADDITIONAL INFORMATION : FOR 4 IN IPS ALUMINIUM TUBE, TYPE : RIGID/SLIDING, DRAWING NO : 50964 SCHEDULE 2: PART NAME : TERMINAL CONNECTOR, ISOLATOR CU STUD, PART RATING : 3150 A, EQUIPME NT NAME : EHV SWITCH YARD, EQUIPMENT RATING : 400 KV, ADDITIONAL INFORMATION : FOR 4 IN IPS AL UMINIUM TUBE, TYPE : EXPANSION, DRAWING NO : 50953 2. Delivery Period: 6-8 weeks from date of APPROVAL OF DRAWINGS. VENDOR WILL SUBMIT THEIR DRA WINGS of QUOTED CLAMPS/ CONNECTORS WITHIN 10 DAYS OF AWARD OF GeM CONTRACT FOR APPROVAL BY PPCL 3. Test Certificate: Applicable 4. INTERCHANGEABILITY: Applicable, The supplied material/ items will be interchangeable with the item s existing in PPCL and if fails to interchange the same shall be replaced free of cost. 5. Special Terms & conditions 5.1-SUPPLIED MATERIAL SHALL BE INTERCHANGEABLE WITH EXISTING MATERIAL 5.2-THE MATERIAL SHALL BE DISPATCHED, IN MOST SECURELY PACKED CONDITIONS 5.3- ALL THE CLAMPS/ CONNECTORS SHALL BE STRICTLY AS PER THE RESPECTIVE DRAWINGS ATTACHED AND SHALL COMPLY ALL THE NOTES/ SPECIFICATIONS MENTIONED IN THE RESPECTIVE DRAWINGS. 5.4- THE DIMENSIONS, MATERIAL USED AND APPROX WEIGHT OF EACH TYPE OF CLAMP/ CONNECTORS ARE GIVEN IN RESPECTIVE DRAWINGS. 5.5- ALL THE CLAMPS/ CONNECTORS SHALL BE SUPPLIED ALONG WITH THE ASSOCIATED HARDWARES AS PER RESPECTIVE DRAWINGS

5.6- CLAMPS SHALL BE DESIGNED TO CARRY THE SAME CURRENT AS THE CONDUCTOR AND THE TEMPERA TURE RISE SHALL BE EQUAL OR LESS THAN THAT OF THE CONDUCTOR AT THE SPECIFIED AMBIENT TEMPE RATURE. 5.7- ALL CURRENT CARRYING PARTS SHALL BE DESIGNED AND MANUFACTURED TO HAVE MINIMUM CONT ACT RESISTANCE. 5.8- CONNECTORS/SPARES REQUIRED SHALL BE COMPLETE WITH ALL COMPONENTS WHICH ARE NECESSA RY FOR THEIR EFFICIENT PERFORMANCE AND SATISFACTORY MAINTENANCE. . 5.9- THE CONNECTORS/SPARES SHALL BE FREE FROM ANY SHARP EDGES AND BURRS, SHALL BE BURNISH ED TO ACHIEVE OPTIMUM SURFACE ROUGHNESS FOR ELECTRICAL CONTACT. 5.10- CLAMPS AND CONNECTORS SHALL BE CONFIRMING THE IS:5561-1970 OR LATEST. 5.11- VENDOR WILL SUBMIT THEIR DRAWINGS of QUOTED CLAMPS/CONNECTORS WITHIN 10 DAYS OF AW ARD OF PO FOR APPROVAL BY PPCL 5.12- MATERIAL COMPOSITION TEST CERTIFICATE, tensile test, visual inspection , DIMENSION CHECK, GAL VANISING TEST FOR THE CLAMPS/ CONNECTORS SHALL BE SUBMITTED BY VENDOR AT THE TIME OF SUPPL Y. 5.13- THE BOLTS, NUTS AND PLAIN WASHERS SHALL BE MS HOT DIPPED GALVANISED AS PER IS:2629 AND TESTED AS PER IS:2633. SPRING WASHERS SHALL BE ELECTRO GALVANISED AS PER IS:1573 5.14- ACSR MOOSE CONDUCTOR REQUIRED FOR THE CLAMP/CONNECTOR MANUFACTURING SHALL BE PROVIDED BY PPCL AND SAME SHALL BE RECEIVED BY VENDOR FROM PPS-3 PLANT BAWANA after submiss ion of Security Deposit:. 6. PBG: Applicable as per GeM E-PBG @ 5% with validity 20 months 7. Security Deposit: SD clause applicable as per NIT which is @5% of GeM PO/contract value and shall b e released after successful completion of PO. This SD is applicable in addition to E-PBG in e-PBG details tab in GeM bid. 7. Under MSE category (Micro & Small Enterprises), only manufacturers o f goods are eligible for exemption from EMD. Traders are excluded from the purview of this Po licy Note: Bid of different vendors received from same IP address will not be considered and bid s hall be out rightly rejected for this tender.
